summary: Country-specific anomalies like Bhutan's traffic signal rule pulled the highest view counts, while broad facts about global monuments got less initial traction. Competitor performance indicates massive viral demand for ancient Indian engineering secrets and bizarre country laws presented in fast Hinglish narration. Moving forward, the channel will double down on mysterious Indian architectural marvels and radical country secrets with aggressive first-second visual hooks.
do_more: Focus on mysterious Indian engineering wonders like floating pillars, non-rusting iron, and stepwells
Lead with extreme country anomalies and bizarre local rules that create instant curiosity
Keep video pacing under 35 seconds to maximize average percentage watched and complete seamless loops
Use high-contrast visual side-by-side reveals in the first 1.5 seconds to minimize swipe-away rate
avoid: Broad textbook trivia like wall lengths without a specific hidden mystery angle
Slow introductions or delay in presenting the central anomaly past 2 seconds
Generic video titles missing an extreme statistic, single emoji, or high curiosity gap
Static imagery or slow panning without dynamic graphics and sound effects
